title: Confirmation-campaign contract v2: confirmation-aware vs strong simple predictors under identical information, deadline and binding-resource cap
status: FROZEN by protocol/freeze.json before the first outcome read of this study. v2 adopts the independent pre-freeze challenge (verify/contract_challenge.json); the superseded draft is protocol/campaign_contract_draft_v1.json.
evidence_status: Jaaks et al. 2022 (figshare 16843597, SHA-256 1188968c...a278) was opened by feedback_validation_20261003 and analysed by reproducible_allocation_20261003 (including R vs S_both under a 5-round verify-hits replay on all lines). Everything in this study that reads it is EXPLORATORY; every verdict carries the prefix EXPLORATORY_. New scripts, partitions or seeds do not make it untouched. Historical thresholds, stop rules, failures and verdicts of earlier studies are unchanged.
primary_question: Under identical two-orientation historical information, an identical two-round deadline and an identical binding-resource cap, does the confirmation-aware predictor R (shrunk empirical joint-call rate) obtain more measured confirmed discoveries than the development-selected strongest simple same-information predictor C*?
secondary_question: Does purchased target-line feedback improve relative action value (within-line ordering of candidates) beyond a line-level correction of the response level? Gated; one diagnostic only.

action_menu.candidates: per target line and role assignment (SV, VS): the registered S x V menu pairs of the frozen builder research/astra/feedback_validation_20261003/jaaks.py (pairs with both orientations present after the authors' QC), in builder order (sorted (s, v))
action_menu.screen(i): buy the screen-orientation measurement of pair i (SV: S drug anchored, V titrated; VS: reversed); its label and call are revealed at the end of the round
action_menu.verify(i): buy the other orientation of pair i (disjoint plates); allowed only if screen(i) was bought in an EARLIER round and its call was synergistic; revealed at the end of the round
action_menu.stop: buy nothing more; the cap need not be spent
action_menu.limitation_M1: the menu requires both orientations to pass the authors' QC, so it conditions on target-line fit outcomes (identical for all arms; external validity overstated). The design workstream reports per line the design-menu pairs excluded by QC.

endpoint.primary: measured confirmed discoveries: pairs with a synergistic screen call AND a synergistic verification call, both revealed through purchases before the deadline. Calls = the frozen builder's panel screen_hit / valid_hit (authors' rule: >= half of replicate rows per anchor concentration, either concentration).
endpoint.line_value: mean over the two role assignments of the line (paired; never two units). SV and VS are also reported separately as a diagnostic (note M4: R, S_both, C_mean and C_prod rank identically in SV and VS; C_s, C_v, L_v do not).
endpoint.aggregate: sum over evaluation lines; reported absolute (mean per line) and relative (ratio of sums - 1)
endpoint.missed: menu joint-hit pairs not confirmed by the deadline, split into never screened and screened-not-verified
endpoint.future_information_utility: none registered: an unverified screen at the deadline has zero utility

legal_information.history_rows: for target t and role r, H = all menu rows (every pair) of panel <tissue>_<r> whose line is in hist(t): E target -> all HD lines of the tissue; HD target -> HD lines of the tissue except t. Rows of t and of every E line are removed from BOTH role panels before any computation. Screen label = library y, verification label = valid_y, screen call = screen_hit, verification call = valid_hit.
legal_information.target_line: only measurements purchased in earlier rounds of the same campaign. Never the target line's unpurchased outcomes; never the other role assignment of the same line (its screen measurements are this assignment's verification measurements).
legal_information.excluded: single-drug functional probes, cell identity or omics features, cheap pre-decision state, LLM output

units.experimental_unit: target cell line (125: 51 breast, 45 colon, 29 pancreas), stratified by tissue
units.partition: protocol/partition.json (design-only, seed [20261004, tissue code]): E = 61 evaluation lines (25/22/14), HD = 64 history-and-development lines (26/23/15); repeat lines 8 in E, 6 in HD
units.dependence: drug pairs recur across lines (two-way line x pair bootstrap sensitivity); all E targets share one fixed HD history library and the selected C*/f* (estimand: new lines, this library, this history, this selected comparator); plates of one line share culture expansions and seeding events (no unit below the line). HD development targets use n_HD - 1 history lines, E targets n_HD (L2).

resource_cap.binding_resource_primary: orientation measurements: M = (menu + 4) // 5 (= ceil(0.20 x menu), integer) per line and role assignment; one purchase = one orientation measurement (all its release plates)
resource_cap.binding_resource_sensitivity: combination wells: W = ceil(Fraction(M) x sum over the line's menu of (c_screen + c_verify) / (2 x menu)) with exact rational arithmetic; c = 14 x design plates (pre-QC) behind that line, orientation and pair. P2 under W: round-1 well budget floor((100 - fp) x W / 100); greedy in screen order, skip a candidate that does not fit and continue; round 2 verifies round-1 hits in verify order, skipping those that do not fit W - spent.
resource_cap.cap_semantics: a cap, not a spending requirement; consumption is reported next to the cap, including unavoidable odd residues
resource_cap.reported_not_matched: dose points (14 per orientation measurement per plate), combination wells, distinct native plates and seeding events touched (M7), custom 1536-well plate starts, control wells (documented 200 per plate; raw layout 216-254), shared single-agent wells, failures, rounds USED per campaign and minimum elapsed days (4 per used round: seed-to-read on all 3,106 raw plates), computation. Prices, labour, culture capacity and days beyond the assay stay null. No physical-saving claim follows from the measurement cap.

deadline.frontier: 1, 2 and 3 rounds (resources workstream) with the stopping rule

policies.integer_arithmetic: f is an integer percent fp in {10, 15, ..., 60}; n1 = ((100 - fp) x M) // 100; P3 round-1 screens = (M + 1) // 2; P1 pairs = M // 2
policies.P2_primary_fixed_split: round 1: screen the first n1 candidates of the screen order; round 2: verify round-1 screen hits in verify order while spent < M; no round-2 screens; stop. Campaigns with n1 = 0 are kept and counted (M5).
policies.P3_sensitivity_verify_hits: round 1: screen the first (M + 1) // 2 candidates of the screen order. Round 2: v2 = min(#round-1 hits, M - n_r1) verifications in verify order; B2 = M - n_r1 - v2; iterate unscreened candidates in the static screen order and accept candidate j iff (k + 1) + ceil(round(sum of shrunk history p_s over the k accepted plus j, 12)) <= B2, p_s = the role's shrunk screen-call rate (identical for every predictor); stop at the first failure (no skipping). Round 3: verify round-2 hits in verify order up to M - spent; no round-3 screens; stop. Non-feedback arms never use round-1 outcomes for the round-2 screen order.
policies.P1_frontier_paired: 1 round: both orientations of the first M // 2 pairs of the screen order (resources frontier only)
policies.tie_break: line index = position of the SIDM in the frozen builder's per-tissue lines tuple (sorted SIDM of the whole tissue library); role index SV = 0, VS = 1; base order = the line's menu rows in builder order; perm = numpy default_rng([20261004, tissue_code, line_index, role_index]).permutation(n_menu); rank[perm[k]] = k; screen order and verify order = numpy.lexsort((rank, -numpy.round(score, 12))). Same rule for every predictor, the oracle and diagnostics. tissue_code Breast 1, Colon 2, Pancreas 3.

predictors.pooled_quantities: computed on H (all pairs): pooled_p_s = mean screen_hit, pooled_p_v = mean valid_hit, pooled_p_sv = mean(screen_hit and valid_hit), pooled_p_v|s = sum(joint)/sum(screen_hit) (pooled_p_v if sum(screen_hit) = 0), pooled label means = mean over H
predictors.shrinkage: per pair, n = rows of H with that pair (one per history line), k0 = 2 for every predictor: rate = (count + 2 x pooled)/(n + 2); label mean = (sum + 2 x pooled_mean)/(n + 2); p_v|s = (n_joint + 2 x pooled_p_v|s)/(n_screen_hits + 2); pairs with n = 0 get the pooled value
predictors.R: screen score p_sv; verify score p_v|s. A simple shrunk empirical rate, not a learned world model.
predictors.S_both: screen and verify score: shrunk mean of (screen label + verification label)/2
predictors.L_v: shrunk mean of the verification label (both scores)
predictors.C_mean: screen score (shrunk p_s + shrunk p_v)/2; verify score shrunk p_v
predictors.C_prod: screen score shrunk p_s x shrunk p_v; verify score shrunk p_v
predictors.S: shrunk mean of the screen-orientation label only, both scores (one-orientation history; information-package comparison only, never a same-information comparator)
predictors.oracle: ranking by the true joint outcome (headroom only; never a comparator)

comparator_selection: on HD development targets only, under P2 with the primary cap: development yield = sum over all 64 HD lines (pooled across tissues) of the line value. For each simple same-information predictor {S_both, L_v, C_s, C_v, C_mean, C_prod} choose its best fp (ties -> smaller fp); C* = the predictor with the highest development yield at its best fp (ties in the listed order); fp* = C*'s best fp. R and S are excluded. All predictors, including R, use fp* on E (primary). R's own HD-best fp is also selected on HD and written to design/selection.json before E is used (H2). selection.json records fp* as an integer, C*, and the full development table.

contrasts.primary: R - C* on E lines under P2 (orientation-measurement cap, 2 rounds, fp*)
secondary_registered_descriptive: each predictor at its own HD-selected fp (R vs C*) (H2)
R - S_both (if C* is not S_both)
S_both - S and R - S (information package, not modelling contribution)
P3 versions of the primary and of R - S_both
combination-well cap version of the primary
all-lines leave-one-line-out history sensitivity (125 lines, shared histories)
two-way line x pair bootstrap of the primary
contrasts.reported_for_each: absolute per-line difference and relative gain with 95% intervals; concordance; calibration and prediction error (R and C_prod only); consumption, screen hits, verifications, confirmation rate, missed discoveries, rounds used, native plates touched
contrasts.metric_definitions: concordance = per campaign AUC of the rounded screen score against the binary joint call over the menu (score ties 0.5; campaigns with 0 or all joint hits undefined, counted); line value = mean over defined roles; aggregate = mean over lines. Brier and log loss of the joint call over the menu for R (p_sv) and C_prod (p_s x p_v), probabilities clipped to [1e-6, 1 - 1e-6].

inference: rng = numpy default_rng(20261004); E lines sorted by SIDM within tissue; for b in range(10000): for tissue in (Breast, Colon, Pancreas): idx = rng.integers(0, n_t, n_t); relative = sum(R)/sum(C*) - 1 over the concatenated resample; the absolute per-line difference uses the same indices; interval = numpy.percentile(values, [2.5, 97.5]) (linear). Resamples with sum(C*) = 0 are counted; if more than 1% are affected the verdict uses the absolute interval relative to tau x mean C* yield.

worthwhile_gain.basis: inherited from reproducible_allocation_20261003/review/statistics.json (recommended_tau 0.05 at fixed rounds and resources), not re-tuned; R and C* use the same information and resources, so tau is the smallest gain worth a confirmatory study and a change of the default ranking

decision_rules_primary.EXPLORATORY_WORTHWHILE_EXCLUDED: 0 <= U < tau and L <= 0 -> STOP (worthwhile benefit ruled out)
decision_rules_primary.EXPLORATORY_SMALL_BENEFIT: L > 0 and U < tau -> R is a free development-grade default; STOP pursuing confirmation
decision_rules_primary.EXPLORATORY_BENEFIT_DETECTED: 0 < L <= tau <= U -> CONTINUE: freeze a confirmatory protocol for an untouched source, conditional on data qualification
decision_rules_primary.EXPLORATORY_UNRESOLVED: L <= 0 and U >= tau -> MODIFY: no claim; more or qualified data needed
decision_rules_primary.qualification: a HARM or WORTHWHILE_EXCLUDED verdict is stated 'at the C*-optimal split' unless the own-fp secondary agrees in sign (H2); every verdict is 'for this history library and selected comparator' (L3)
decision_rules_primary.note: a lower bound below tau never establishes futility; L, U = 95% interval of the relative gain

feedback_diagnostic.gate: computed on HD development campaigns (HD line x role) with predictor R under P3, written to design/feedback_gate.json before the diagnostic: (a) round-2 headroom: hold R's round-1 purchases fixed and let an oracle choose only the round-2 screens by the true joint outcome (same count and reserve rule); pass iff its HD yield exceeds R's P3 HD yield by >= 5% relative; (b) pass iff >= 50% of HD campaigns buy >= 1 round-2 screen. Run the diagnostic only if (a) and (b) pass.
feedback_diagnostic.signal: F_i = frozen TransferWorld (WorldConfig(context=False)) posterior mean minus prior mean on the screen scale, given the campaign's purchased round-1 screen labels; world fitted on the <tissue>_<role> panel with every E line excluded for HD campaigns, and every other E line excluded for E campaigns (asserted in code); F_i = m_line + f_i, m_line = mean of F over the eligible set (the campaign's unscreened menu candidates at the round-2 decision), f_i = F_i - m_line

models.F0: logit P(joint) = a + b x logit(p_sv of R), b constrained > 0
models.Fm: F0 + c_m x m_line (line-level correction; same within-line order as F0: a calibration-only comparison)
models.Ff: Fm + c_f x f_i (one centered coefficient; c_f = 0 if its HD development 95% line-bootstrap interval contains 0)

feedback_diagnostic.scope: F0/Fm/Ff change only the round-2 screen order under P3 (verify order p_v|s and reserve p_s unchanged); coefficients fitted on HD campaigns only (legal hidden outcomes of development lines)
feedback_diagnostic.comparators: existing rankings from reproducible_allocation_20261003/repeats/model_id.py: U_lambda (V0 + lambda x F) and U_screen_post (posterior on the screen scale); all reported (no cherry-picking; the same-condition receipt has U_lambda 9.0, U_V0 7.5, U_screen_post 9.5)
feedback_diagnostic.endpoints: relative action value = within-campaign AUC among eligible round-2 candidates of the prediction against the realised joint outcome (predictions frozen before the round-2 reveal); level correction = calibration-in-the-large and log loss; confirmed yield under P3
feedback_diagnostic.decision: EXPLORATORY_RELATIVE_FEEDBACK_VALUE iff c_f != 0 and the E line-bootstrap 95% interval of (AUC Ff - AUC Fm) excludes 0 on the positive side; otherwise EXPLORATORY_NO_RELATIVE_FEEDBACK_VALUE
feedback_diagnostic.targets: role-swapped transport (all lines) and same-condition repeatability (repeat lines only, seeding-event roles from the provenance receipt) reported separately; same-condition is development-grade (14 lines)
feedback_diagnostic.logging: every campaign: predictions frozen (hashed) before each paid reveal, scored before updating, complete reveal-score-update history in JSONL
feedback_diagnostic.limits: no latent blocks, networks or feature search; two-parameter logistic calibration is not a new contribution

outputs_for_verification: design writes per (predictor, fp, line, role) JSONL: n_menu, M, n1, ordered screen list, screen hits, ordered verify list, verification hits, confirmed, spent, rounds used (M8)
scheduler_and_llm: no scheduler or LLM arm; added only if the resources diagnostics show substantive choices among screening, verification and stopping that the simple rules mishandle (registered before any such arm is run). p_sv/(c_s + p_s x c_v) is reported as a pipeline diagnostic, not an optimal policy.
power: computed by the design workstream from HD development variance of R - C* under P2 before E outcomes are used: detection (L > 0), demonstration (L > tau) and rule-out (U < tau) for n_E = 61 and other n
data_qualification: verify workstream: bounded recovery attempts for an untouched evaluation of a narrower estimand (design metadata first; builder and analysis frozen before any target outcome is opened); otherwise a blocking receipt with the minimum missing evidence
provider_api: none planned; cap USD 3 if a necessary diagnostic arises; no secrets logged
amendments_before_freeze: v2 adopts B1, B2, H1-H6, M1-M8 and L1-L5 of verify/contract_challenge.json (integer arithmetic; exact tie-break; exact history rows and pooled rates; own-fp secondary and verdict qualification; E lines excluded from the TransferWorld fit; exact P3 reserve; round-2 headroom gate with b > 0 and a registered diagnostic decision; exact bootstrap; QC-conditioned menu limitation; wells-cap policy; metric definitions; role symmetry note; n1 = 0 reporting and menu < 10 sensitivity; EXPLORATORY_ verdict prefix; native plates touched; per-campaign JSONL; S naming; rounds used). No outcome of this study had been read.
